$comment: The guide's narration for Madeleine Albright, written to sound like a museum guide (owner decision 2026-10-17), in the same way as einstein.json. A fact line's 'source' is the verified claim (data/inductees/albright/facts.jsonl, status verified), verbatim; 'text' is the caption and what is spoken; 'speak' (optional) only spells out an abbreviation or a number for the voice. A 'room-note' line says what the room model shows, not a fact about Madeleine Albright: its 'source' lists verbatim excerpts of 'basis' (the room's INVENTORY.md), and it may use no content word, date or number those excerpts lack. assets-src/audio/check_narration.py gates both kinds. Audio: build_guide_audio.py, one clip per line per guide voice.
